text: Veriff approved the passport check for ELVIRA VELASCO MORILLO on 2023-09-15. Document issued by Spain; date of birth shown as 05/03/1968.

source.original: Verified via Veriff on 2023-09-15: passport from Spain, name ELVIRA VELASCO MORILLO, DOB 05/03/1968.
source.why: CRM CUS-377745 declares the same DOB 1968-03-05, so the decision survives a dropped note. 05/03/1968 is copied from the original; bank-side slash dates are DD/MM and the label gives 1968-03-05.

text: Identity check passed: Onfido matched COSTA MARCOS GIULIA ROBERTO to a Brazilian national ID card on 15 August 2025. Date of birth taken from the card: 12th of September 1985.

source.original: Onfido successfully verified the national ID for COSTA MARCOS GIULIA ROBERTO (12/09/1985) on 2025-08-15. The documentation is from Brazil.
source.why: Diagnostic only together with SR-590704 (see e2e).

e2e.why: SR-590704 is the hit's only DOB source, so a dropped age turns the decision into REVIEW. CRM CUS-775419 and CUS-138588 repeat the note's DOB, so only the evidence citation detects a dropped note fact.

text: Veriff check 2025-02-02 / date of birth 1977-01-11 / passport issued by France / holder KERVIEL JEROME / outcome: approved.

source.original: The Veriff process successfully validated KERVIEL JEROME on 2025-02-02, referencing a France passport and a birth date of January 11, 1977.
source.why: The first ISO date in this note is the check date, not the birth date.

e2e.why: CRM CUS-626609 declares dob 1969-05-05. If the note's DOB is dropped, or the check date is read as the DOB, the hit's 1976/1977 is contradicted and the hit is cleared unsafely. SR-01BFC3 is the hit's only DOB source.

text: Onfido signed off MICHAEL EARL TILLEY's driving licence, issued in the United States, as genuine on 25 November 2023. Holder born 8th of November 1979.

source.original: On 2023-11-25, Onfido validated the driving licence from United States for MICHAEL EARL TILLEY, DOB 1979-11-08.
source.why: Only verified DOB (no KYC-provider check exists).

e2e.why: CRM CUS-804632 declares the same 1979-11-08, so the decision alone survives a dropped note; the evidence citation is what detects it.

text: Result of Veriff review (26 Nov 2023): approved. Document: national identity card, Serbia. Name on document: ALEKSANDAR RASKOVIC. Date of birth: 17.04.1979.

source.original: Veriff validated the Serbia national ID for ALEKSANDAR RASKOVIC, born 17 April 1979, on 2023-11-26.
source.why: Only DOB of the customer.

e2e.why: CRM CUS-270502 has no DOB and there is no KYC-provider check, so the note is the customer's only DOB; a dropped fact turns the decision into REVIEW.

text: A Bangladeshi driving licence held by TASLIMA RAHIM ISLAM was accepted by Onfido on 21 March 2024. Recorded birth date: 4 May 1994.

source.original: On 2024-03-21, Onfido verified the driving licence for TASLIMA RAHIM ISLAM (DOB 1994-05-04), originating from Bangladesh.
source.why: Only verified name.

e2e.why: CRM CUS-171566 and CUS-786038 say 'Md. Saidul Islam', which agrees with the hit, so a dropped verified name loses the clearance.

text: Sumsub approved the passport check on 2023-12-23. Holder: MILAN SETFANOVIĆ. Issuing country: Slovenia. Born on the 9th of February 1989.

source.original: On 2023-12-23, Sumsub successfully validated a passport for Slovenia, identifying the holder as MILAN SETFANOVIĆ, born 09/02/1989.
source.why: REVIEW only because the hit has no DOB to compare; the expected extraction is the note's DOB and country. CRM CUS-839781 has February 9, 1989, confirming the DD/MM reading of 09/02/1989. The name typo is kept as verified.

text: JUAN GONZÁLEZ, born Dec. 6th 1989, holds a passport from Panama that Persona checked and approved as of 2023-08-03.

source.original: As of 2023-08-03, Persona completed the passport verification for JUAN GONZÁLEZ (December 6, 1989) issued in Panama.
source.why: REVIEW only because the hit has no DOB to compare (several people fit the alert); facts only.

text: Onfido could not verify the passport presented by HELENA MARTINS (DOB 14 July 1986, Portugal) on 2024-02-11: the photo did not match the selfie, so the check was rejected.

source.why: Rejected check: POLICY.md principle 4, not evidence.

text: The identity check for DAVID OKONKWO-REYES expired on 2025-06-02 before it was completed. The uploaded Nigerian ID showed a date of birth of 30.11.1979.

source.why: Expired check: not evidence.

text: Persona declined the verification of KAMAL HOSSAIN on 2023-10-09 because his Bangladeshi passport (born 2 January 1975) appeared to have been altered.

source.why: Declined check worded without 'rejected'.

text: Asked about an earlier international transfer, the customer explained that the money came from savings made while living and working in India in 2013–2014.

source.original: The customer noted that their past international transfer originated from their time living and working in India between 2013 and 2014.
source.why: REVIEW because the hit's DOB cannot be compared; facts only. Keeps the transfer and the residence together: a parser that discards every note mentioning a transfer fails here (trap twin: PB-RTR-01).

text: Between 2014 and 2018 the client's home and job were both in Ghana.

source.original: The customer maintained residence and employment in Ghana for the duration of 2014 to 2018.
source.why: Still clears on location without Ghana: the customer's other records tie them to the Netherlands and the hit only to the United States. A decision check would not notice the miss.

text: According to the account holder, the years 2013 to 2023 were spent living and employed in the US.

source.original: The account holder reported living and working in the United States between 2013 and 2023.
source.why: REVIEW because the hit's DOB cannot be compared; facts only. Country given as a code.

text: The client says they were a Danish resident, working locally, from 2016 until they relocated in 2018.

source.original: The client confirmed their employment and residency in Denmark from 2016 to 2018 before their relocation.
source.why: REVIEW because the hit's DOB cannot be compared; facts only. Country given as a demonym.

text: The customer mentioned relocating to Peru for work in 2015 and staying there until 2019.

source.why: Relocation wording; no 'lived' or 'resided' verb.

text: The customer lived in Spain from 2012 to 2016; her husband is from Morocco.

source.why: Customer residence plus a third-party country that must not be added.

text: The customer explained that their past international transfer was money sent to India.

source.original: The customer noted that their past international transfer originated from their time living and working in India between 2013 and 2014.
source.why: Derived from NOTE-7F183D with the residence clause removed: the transfer alone ties the customer to no country (twin: PB-RES-01).

text: The customer asked why the money they sent to Peru in March 2024 has not arrived yet.

source.why: Outgoing transfer destination ('sent money to Peru'), not residence.

text: The customer's brother has lived in Peru since 2010; the customer asked how to send him money.

source.why: Third-party residence.

text: The client clarified that they have never lived or worked in Brazil.

source.why: Negated residence.

text: The card was blocked while the customer was on a two-week holiday in Thailand in 2025.

source.why: Travel, not residence.

text: The customer's spouse lived and worked in Germany from 2012 to 2016 and is now applying for a joint account.

source.why: Third-party residence with the same 'lived and worked' wording as real residence notes.

text: Michael Earl Tilley, then 46, was questioned by investigators in January 2023.

source.original: When investigators conducted questioning of Michael Earl Tilley in January 2023, he was 46.
source.why: The label puts the hit's birth year at 1976 or 1977 from this sentence.

e2e.why: The profile is a single paragraph and the hit's only DOB source (dobs empty, no search result used); a dropped age leaves nothing to compare and the decision becomes REVIEW.

text: Abdul Rahman Yasin's date of birth is given as the 10th of April, 1960.

source.original: Abdul Rahman Yasin was born on 10 April 1960.
source.why: Same paragraph 1 in H-D6AE72, H-22A09C and H-44F5F0; only paragraph 1 is reworded.

text: Tomasz Wielicki was aged 45 when a regional court sentenced him in March 2019.

source.why: The worked example in POLICY.md principle 5 (aged 45 in March 2019 -> 1973 or 1974), reworded.

text: According to the regional prosecutor's office; March 3, 2015: Henrik Saltnes, 52, was charged with embezzlement from a municipal pension fund.

source.why: The stable dated-report line is kept verbatim; the age is read at the report date.

text: Kofi Adomako-Mensah was first arrested in October 2008; he was 24 at the time.

source.why: Pronoun subject and the reference date in an earlier clause ('he was 24').

text:
Rafael Quintero Lobo was born in May 1958 in Valencia, Venezuela.

In 2011 he was sentenced to 12 years in prison.

source.why: Month-year birth date; paragraph 2 carries a prison term that is not an age.

text: Darius Velkov was sentenced in April 2017 to 12 years in prison for money laundering.

source.why: A prison term is not an age.

text: Designation no. 184 / 22.11.2011 / YUSUF KARIMOV / listed by the State Security Cabinet.

source.why: Administrative listing date, as in H-FF3096 paragraph 1; not a birth date.

text:
Graham Oyelaran-Pike was indicted on wire fraud charges in federal court.

Jail roster entry: Name: Graham Oyelaran-Pike; Age: 44; Booked: December 2021.

source.why: Age only in a later paragraph (dev example: H-666325, 'Age: 44' in paragraph 3). POLICY.md principle 5 reads paragraph 1 only.

text: Reported by elpais.com on October 28, 2021: Ramón Ibarra Soler was sentenced to two years in prison for forgery.

source.why: Reworded report line. POLICY.md fixes the 'According to …; Month D, YYYY:' form, so this is not a dated report and gives no earliest report date.

text: MARCOS ROBERTO COSTA, a politically exposed person in Brazil, was 33 when news reports profiled him in May 2019.

source.original: May 2019 news reports profiled 33 year old MARCOS ROBERTO COSTA, who is a politically exposed person in Brazil.
source.why: The label puts the hit's birth year at 1985 or 1986. Category from categories[0] (PEP); country from the hit's nationality field.

text: A February 2010 news profile covered Jérôme Kerviel, 33, who had been named in adverse media in France.

source.original: In February 2010, at the age of 33, Jérôme Kerviel was the subject of a news outlet profile after being named in adverse media in France.
source.why: The label puts the hit's birth year at 1976 or 1977.

text: Aleksandar Raković was 29 and a politically exposed person in Serbia when a regulator's notice listed him in May 2002.

source.original: A regulator's notice from May 2002 listed Aleksandar Raković, 29, a politically exposed person in Serbia.
source.why: The label puts the hit's birth year at 1972 or 1973.

e2e.why: The hit has no dobs and no paragraph-1 DOB, so this snippet is its only DOB; a dropped age turns the decision into REVIEW.

text: Teodora Valcheva, 41, was named in adverse media in Bulgaria in a March 2016 local report.

source.why: Right name and country, but the listing is adverse media, not 'a sanctioned individual'.
